snippet.title: Chief Extermination Officer: Business as Usual | an Asymmetric VR Party Game
snippet.description:
One player runs the factory on Meta Quest, up to 8 friends ruin it from their Android phones.

The staff of C.E.O. Burgers walked out over the pests. It made the evening news. So the CEO straightened his tie, dusted off his shoulders and decided to run the factory himself. It went well for about five seconds.

Play the CEO in VR on Meta Quest: catch ingredients, stack the orders, and swat, spray, zap and trap the pests.

Play the pests on your Android phone or tablet: rats, cockroaches, ants, spiders, flies and wasps. Steal the food, grease it, web it, ship yourself in disguise, and pull the factory's levers.

Everyone takes a turn as the CEO.

The pest app is free and Android only (phones and tablets; there is no iOS version yet), so friends only need an Android device to join.
Local play only: no accounts, no servers, no internet needed.

CEO is in Early Access: the game is playable start to finish and keeps growing with your feedback.

Watch the official trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X92uVpiRgfU

Meta Horizon Store: https://www.meta.com/experiences/ceo-chief-extermination-officer/1315597341644508
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mihalovics.ceo

Website: https://ceo.mihalovics.com
Made by Mihalovics Labs: https://labs.mihalovics.com
